title: COP31 negotiators publish revised deal text, no mention of fossil fuels
description: Climate negotiators on Thursday published a second draft of the deal they are hoping to agree this week at the COP31 meeting in Antalya Turkey The latest draft removed any reference to fossil fuels which scientists say are driving global warming The first draft had contained two references to fossil fuels and limiting their use

title: This colossal statue was a wonder of the ancient world – until 900 camels took it away
description: The giant statue of a god inspired awe in ancient travellers to the island of Rhodes, but it did not last long as a wonder before it came crashing down

title: Scientists discover lost ancient emperor arch echoing Trump’s DC design
description: Archaeologists have unearthed a 1,900-year-old Roman triumphal arch with striking similarities to President Donald Trump’s proposed Washington monument.

title: Chamomile: An Ancient Herb for Easing Stress, Inducing Sleep, and Infusing Calm
description: Chamomile can be used as a tea, in a bath, or simply inhaled–its apple-like scent helps your body and mind relax.

title: Ancient Maya site uncovered with ‘vibe archaeology’ ignites firestorm over AI in science
description: Contrary to online claims, AI did not discover an ancient Maya site. But it did spark a clash over how the technology should be used in science
